一辆车到达终点。: A truck has reached the end.
护送车队穿过雪祭会场: Escort the convoy through the Snow Festival grounds
三辆车里至少两辆到达港口。车归护送队，你指挥不了，只能护送。: At least two of the three trucks must reach the harbor. The trucks drive themselves; you can only escort them.
车队开得慢，约 4 分钟才到，这中间号角会响五声。号角一响，三条街同时出兵扑车；: The convoy is slow: about 4 minutes to get there, and the horn sounds five times on the way. Each horn sends troops down all three streets at the trucks. Freeze a street shut and its troops detour to a street that is open. Watch the countdown, then decide which one to freeze. You start with one Ice Engineer; Command will send more, up to two.
拆掉北营的指挥所: Destroy the command post of the north camp
北高原上的帝国营地会自己造兵，港口桥头的兵也是它派的。指挥所一倒，桥头的兵撤回去: The Imperial camp on the north plateau builds its own troops, and the troops at the harbor bridge are its doing. Once the command post falls, the bridge troops pull back and the second half begins, so plan the last leg's defense first. The front slope is wide but guarded by Wave-Force Towers; the back slope is narrow, and razing the power plant at its top cuts the towers' power.
占领西岭的电视塔: Capture the TV tower on the west ridge
西北角山岭上的电视塔，走到跟前就归你：看得清北边，最后一程还能看见运输船往哪个口: The TV tower on the northwest ridge is yours the moment you walk up to it. It shows you the north, and on the last leg it shows which mouth the transports are heading for.
把车队送到港口: Deliver the convoy to the harbor
车一辆接一辆从 2 号广场出发，过 3 号广场、运河桥到港口。号角照旧，三个口子: The trucks leave Plaza 2 one after another, through Plaza 3 and over the canal bridge to the harbor. The horn goes on, and all three mouths send troops at once; a frozen mouth holds its troops back until the ice melts, then they all pour out. A landed Ghost King goes for the ice walls first.
选中我，点街口，就地造一道冰墙: Select me, click a street mouth, and I raise an ice wall right there
冰墙立起来了。我要歇 40 秒才能再造一道: The wall is up. I need 40 seconds' rest before I can raise another
电视塔归你了：北边看得清清楚楚。: The TV tower is yours: the north is in plain view.
电视塔看见了：北营的残兵聚在北坡下面。: The tower sees the north camp's remnants gathered at the foot of the north slope.
北营的帝国军动起来了：它会自己造兵打过来。: The Imperial north camp is on the move: it will build troops and attack on its own.
车队还停在 2 号广场门口：拆掉北营的指挥所，桥头的兵撤了，车队才走。: The convoy is still parked at Plaza 2's gate: destroy the north camp's command post; once the bridge troops pull back, the convoy moves.
车队被劫走了……两辆车被毁。: The convoy was hijacked... two trucks destroyed.
沃斯：港口桥头被堵了。车过不去。: Voss: The bridge at the harbor is blocked. The trucks can't get through.
科尔：路堵了？我们的船可不等人，小指挥官。: Cole: Road blocked? My ship won't wait for you, little commander.
沃斯：……收容机构的人，说话都这么冲吗？: Voss: ...Do all the people from the containment agency talk like that?
沃斯：雪祭评委还给三号广场的几座发了金奖。: Voss: The festival judges even gave gold medals to a few of the ones in Plaza 3.
冰幕工兵：选中工兵，点街口，就地造一道冰墙。冰墙挡得住兵，过一阵会化。: Ice Engineer: Select an engineer, click a street mouth, and raise an ice wall on the spot. The wall stops troops; it melts after a while.
沃斯：船上是鬼王。冰墙怕是拦不住那东西。: Voss: The Ghost King is aboard that ship. I doubt an ice wall will stop that thing.
司令：司令部又调来一个冰幕工兵。: Command: Headquarters has sent another Ice Engineer.
科尔：车被劫了一辆，科尔借给你两辆多功能步兵车和一队维和。: Cole: You lost a truck. I'll lend you two IFVs and a peacekeeper squad.
车队的运输车，没有武器，归护送队指挥。: The convoy's transport truck. Unarmed; the escort side drives it.
能在路口冻出一道冰墙，挡住敌人的去路；冰墙过一阵就会化。也能占领建筑。: Freezes an ice wall across a street mouth to block the enemy's way; the wall melts after a while. Can also capture buildings.
走到目标点，站着造一会儿，冻出一道挡路的冰墙（放置时拖动可转方向）。造的时候工兵: Walks to the target point and stands there a moment, freezing a wall that blocks the way (drag while placing to turn it). The engineer has no cover while building; the wall can be shot to pieces and melts after a while.
冰幕工兵正在冻的冰，冻好就是一道冰墙。: Ice the Ice Engineer is freezing; once it sets it is an ice wall.
帝国残部加固过的大冰雕，地道就挖在底座下面。打不坏；号角一响它裂开，兵从底座钻出: A big ice sculpture reinforced by the Imperial remnants, with a tunnel dug under its plinth. Nothing can hurt it; when the horn sounds it splits open and troops climb out.
雪祭会场的展品冰雕，里面没有藏兵。: A festival exhibit. No troops hidden inside.
冰幕工兵冻出的冰墙: Wall Frozen by an Ice Engineer
挡住去路的冰墙，打得碎，过一阵就会化。: An ice wall that blocks the way. It can be shot to pieces and melts after a while.
号角与冰墙: The Horn and the Ice Wall
护送三辆运输车穿过札幌雪祭会场，开到港口，至少两辆到达才算完成。号角一响，三条街: Escort three transport trucks through the Sapporo Snow Festival to the harbor; at least two must arrive. When the horn sounds, tunnels under all three streets send troops after the trucks: use Ice Engineers to freeze walls across the street mouths and make them detour. Destroying the North Camp's command center lets the convoy start its last leg, where troops stacked up behind the three mouths' walls pour out together once the ice melts.
